rule: The map never ranks atmospheres; it shows evidence (ADR-0011).
label: P(droplet flame self-extinguishes before burnout)

defaults.options: M1/M2: Heptane, droplet size = L_mm clipped to the tested range, no CO₂/He; M3: propane, fuel fraction 0.3
defaults.why: Preset vent speed and flame size. They only matter through the widening factor.

what_varies: The estimate depends only on O₂ and pressure (and the default fuel options), not on gravity: the tests flew in microgravity with no imposed flow (ADR-0005). Gravity only widens the band, by one factor for the whole map, so the covered cells and the estimates are the same in every gravity file; only band90 changes.

gate.text: Covered when the habitat is within distance 2 of a tested point in O2, pressure, CO2 and helium (about +/-0.10 O2 mole fraction, a factor of ~1.8 in pressure, or +/-0.20 CO2 or helium mole fraction). A CO2- or helium-diluted habitat is compared only with tests that used that diluent. Habitat air has no CO2 or helium unless a diluent is chosen (ADR-0006).

reading: M1 has evidence in 370 of 520 cells (71% of this map); the rest is no evidence. The lunar base atmosphere (34% O₂, 8.2 psia) is inside the evidence.
